name: 1/7 G.S. Collection [SC] Hatsune Miku Symphony: 10th Anniversary Ver.
description: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Hatsune Miku Symphony with this gorgeous new G.S. Collection [SC] (Signature Class)] figure from Good Smile Company! Our girl Miku dances in front of a grand column with her arms spread wide, while golden ribbons bedecked with stars swirl around her! Her extravagantly ruffled skirt and sleeves are carefully sculpted, with even more ruffles at the cuffs of her stockings; a golden ornament atop the column signifies the 10th anniversary. Miku's hair is especially wonderful, flowing softly around and behind her, made of partially painted clear material for a light and airy feel. There's so much detail in this figure, it's almost dizzying -- the delicate white doves holding the ribbons, Miku's crown and the golden roses she wears in her hair, her shining eyes and big smile!

description: Artist Kei Mochizuki contributed an original illustration of Racing Miku to celebrate her 15th anniversary! She's a member of the G.S. Collection of scale figures, and this special version of Racing Miku has been carefully recreated wearing a pure-white dress, decorated with color-coded ribbons referencing past generations of the character.

name: 1/7 G.S. Collection [SC] Hatsune Miku Symphony 2025: Sapporo Concert Ver.
description: Hatsune Miku is now part of Good Smile Company's G.S. Collection Signature Class scale-figure lineup! The key visual illustration of the Hatsune Miku Symphony Sapporo Concert by the artist Rella has been turned into a beautifully detailed 1/7-scale figure! Parts of Miku's hair have been coated with a holographic finish, and the combination of pearlescent paint and translucent parts gives this figure a unique ephemeral appearance, with the cool colors and snowflake motifs adding a wintery touch -- very appropriate for the Sapporo venue! Her base is included.

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku MAGICAL MIRAI 2026 Ver.
description: Due to restrictions on this item by the manufacturer, we are unable to ship this product to China. The theme for the 14th edition of Magical Mirai is Lake Sonore, and this figure captures Hatsune Miku, as illustrated by the popular artist Wata, descending upon a beautiful lake. She gently holds her straw hat in place with one hand, holding her skirts out of the way with the other, and gives you a smile as refreshing as the cool blue lake she stands lightly upon. Her outfit is loaded with delicately sculpted, multi-layered ruffles conveying a sense of light movement. The brilliant sunflowers that adorn her outfit are meticulously crafted down to the individual petals for a splash of vibrant color! [Materials]: PVC, ABS

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku: Smile x Future Ver.
description: The grand prize-winning entry from the Hatsune Miku x GSC Illustration Contest is now a delightful 1/7-scale figure from Good Smile Company! The theme was Smile x Future, and this image was brought to us by Okada in the first round of the contest. Miku is seen as a figure repair technician, holding her latest project in her left hand as she pauses for a moment with a paintbrush in her right hand. The wide array of tools attached to her kimono attests to her skill, and all of them are sculpted in amazing detail! Her base is included too.

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku: Shimian Maifu Ver. (Rerelease)
description: Good Smile Company's outstanding Shimian Miafu Ver. figure of Hatsune Miku is available for order once more! The world-renowned Vocaloid is given a traditional twist in this elegant figure, with an elaborate outfit and accessories, holding the pipa, a traditional Chinese instrument! The figure is based on an elegant illustration by the artist Rei, in turn inspired by the historical music piece Shimian Maifu. Her pose shows off her gorgeous outfit to its best advantage, with her flowing hair and sorrowful expression giving the figure an unexpectedly emotional impact.

name: POP UP PARADE Hatsune Miku Symphony: 2020 Ver. L Size

description: Good Smile Company brings us a very special 1/7-scale figure of Hatsune Miku, based on the Hatsune Miku Happy 16th Birthday: Music & Fire Works - Time Capsule main visual illustration!The wonder of the illustration by the artist Atiki, featuring Miku standing still against a backdrop of blooming fireworks illuminating the night sky, is faithfully captured in figure form. The refreshing colors of Miku's yukata and her gentle smile will melt your heart. Her long, flowing sash and silky, lustrous twin-tails fluttering in the night breeze are made with clear parts to give the figure a translucent appearance that seems to reflect the glow of the fireworks above! Her base is included.

1/7 Hatsune Miku: Han Gong Qiu Yue Ver.
description: Hatsune Miku gets a new figure from Good Smile Company, based on the theme of Han Gong Qiu Yue, and inspired by an illustration by the artist Rella! This figure brings the elegant yet slightly sorrowful version of Miku straight into your collection; she's seated in a round window, holding a traditional Chinese instrument known as an erhu. Her softly flowing hair spills over the upper edge of the window, echoing the shapes of the clouds at the lower edge, and her scalloped skirt flows gently down in front and back. Elaborate paintwork is used to preserve the moonlit appearance of the original illustration, and a single tear threatens to overflow from her right eye. The lantern at her feet can also be displayed lit up with the use of a light bulb (not included)!

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku: 100th Adventure Ver.
description: Good Smile Company brings us a new 1/7-scale figure of Hatsune Miku, based on the key visual for the 100th Nendoroid Hatsune Miku Commemorative Exhibition! This figure brings the original illustration by KEI to life, giving us a vibrant Miku in a steampunk-inspired explorer's outfit! Her wing-like twin tails are made with translucent parts for a beautiful, breezy appearance, and her base is included.

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku Jiangshi Ver.
description: Due to restrictions on this item by the manufacturer, we are unable to ship this product to China (Macau, Hong Kong, and Taiwan are OK). is now a 1/7-scale figure from Design Coco! Her hands hanging down and her stiff-legged stance express the unique pose of a Jiangshi (also known as a Chinese hopping vampire), and she wears an adorable dissatisfied look on her face with her left cheek puffed out. Her pale, translucent skin, the delicate luster of the beads she wears, and the intricate gradation of her hair color give the figure a stunning finish. Even the back of her outfit, which was not visible in the original illustration, is cute with its open-backed design! Her base is decorated with cracked cobblestones and sharp fence-like parts for a fantastical worldview. [Materials]: PVC, ABS

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku Japan Live Tour 2025 -Blooming-

The figure beautifully captures the energy and mood of illustrator Mai Yoneyama's vibrant artwork, as Miku appears to jump right out of a bouquet! The detailed sculpting on the flowers and Miku's frilly outfit is amazing! A base is included.

name: 1/7 Bishoujo ReMIX series Hatsune Miku (Reissue)
description: Popular Vocaloid digital diva Miku Hatsune returns to Kotobukiya's Bishoujo ReMIX figure series! She's been illustrated and designed in Shunya Yamashita's style as she plays her guitar on stage!Her trademark twin tails are decorated with streaks of pink mixed with her signature teal hair color. The gradient of colors in her hair, from the dark roots to the light tips, are realistically rendered using a clear plastic to give her hair a light, airy quality.Shunya Yamashita's original outfit design features frills all over, which are faithfully recreated thanks to Kotobukiya's expert craftsmanship. The swaying motion of her jacket and skirt are perfectly reproduced, giving Miku a real sense of motion as she strums her guitar! Her base is included. [Materials]: PVC, ABS

description: Kyugetsu is a manufacturing wholesaler of dolls that was founded in the Edo era, famous for their traditional Japanese dolls. Miku's gorgeous kimono is made of actual embroidered fabric which was handcrafted by Kyugetsu's craftsmen, giving this doll a rich texture quite unlike that of other figures! Miku's head and hands were sculpted as figure parts to bring Rella's delicate illustration to life. You'll love the way Miku's twin tails flow around her with her motion, and her sweetly surprised expression. Her base is included.

description: The Snow Miku version of Hatsune Miku and Sanrio's beloved Kuromi combine in this delightful figure from Good Smile Company, inspired by an illustration by PiPi! Kuromi has mischievously dyed parts of Miku's outfit black, and Miku doesn't seem to mind at all! Translucent parts are incorporated into Miku's twin tails to give them a light, airy appearance, with pearlescent paintwork making the colors shift depending on the angle of the light. Her base is included.

name: figma Racing Miku 2024 ver. (Hatsune Miku GT Project)
description: The 2024 version of Racing Miku, the official character of the Hatsune Miku GT Project, is now a figma action figure from Good Smile Company! name: [SMILE VALUE 2025] POP UP PARADE Sakura Miku: Hanami Outfit Ver.
description: Good Smile Company launches their new figure series, [Smile Value 2025] POP UP PARADE, with Sakura Miku! This lineup features figures full of eye-catching details and beautifully done paintwork at an even more affordable price! Sakura Miku is heading out for an afternoon viewing the blossoming cherry trees, and she wears an incredibly cute outfit in pink and white; a motif of sakura petals is repeated throughout her outfit, with her skirt, socks, shoes, and handbag featuring their distinctive pattern. She also wears fun cherry accents in her hair and on the handle of her bag! Her beautiful pink hair has been made with clear material that's partially painted for a smooth gradient finish, and her base has a brick texture.

Her base is included.

Miku wears cat-ear headphones, her shoes look like cat paws, and she even has pointy teeth! name: TENITOL Hatsune Miku YUMEKAWA Princess Lavender ver.
description: FuRyu's TENITOL figure of Hatsune Miku, Dreamy Princess, is back in a new color! This figure is based on an original illustration by the popular artist Eku Uekara, and the coloring is based on the artist's original idea too, giving it an even dreamier atmosphere than before! The relaxing pastel colors make Miku even cuter than before, and the puff sleeves on her blouse use transparent parts! Her base is included.

name: 1/4 Character Vocal Series 01: Hatsune Miku: Hatsune Miku 0x27 Eternal Stream
description: Good Smile Company brings us a big, beautiful 1/4-scale figure of Miku Hatsune, based on an illustration by redjuice! The figure is a faithful reproduction of the MIKU FES '24 (Spring) ~Happy 16th Birthday~ event key visual! Miku drifts through time and the cosmos, singing (of course), with her hair flowing behind her; you'll love the slightly flat, angular sculpting of her hair, in contrast to its usual fluffy appearance. Parts of the figure have been treated to a holographic coating for an amazing multicolored gleaming look, and her shirt and skirt are covered in a layer of clear parts, too! The 0x27 in the figure's title means 39 (pronounced Miku in Japanese) in hexadecimal code! Her base is included.

name: TENITOL Hatsune Miku GALAXY LIVE ver.
description: The popular illustrator Reoenl's illustration of Hatsune Miku hails from the Galaxy Live 2021 event, and now FuRyu brings her into their TENITOL figure series! Her voluminous hair has been faithfully reproduced, made of clear parts that are partially painted for a sense of transparency; her softly flaring skirt and the layers of ruffles on her petticoat are also carefully sculpted. She looks off into the distance with a questioning look on her face, carefully cradling a fragile blue flower in her hands. Her base is included too. [Materials]: ATBC-PVC, ABS

description: The 2021 version of Racing Miku, the Hatsune Miku GT Project official character, gets a new figure from Wonderfull Works! Based on a special illustration by designer En Morikura, Miku is sitting on a stool with a suitcase at her feet, wearing a refreshing white summer dress that ruffles softly in the wind, along with her long twin tails! Even her gorgeous earrings are swaying with the wind! Her goggles feature translucent lenses, too. Pink accents on her sandals, the bow on her hat, and her earrings add a pop of brilliant color to this figure.

description: Hatsune Miku reminisces about Mid-Autumn Night, when the moon is said to be at its most beautiful, in this new figure from FuRyu's F:NEX figure brand! name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku MAGICAL MIRAI 2023 Ver.
description: Hatsune Miku Magical Mirai 2023 Ver. 1/7th Scale Figure.Step into the world of Hatsune Miku's Magical Mirai 2023 with Design COCO's latest addition - a 1/7 scale figure capturing the essence of the main visual. In this 11th iteration of Magical Mirai, the theme is HERO, and the spotlight is on the star of the event, Hatsune Miku.In a vibrant crimson costume illustrated by artist LAM, this rendition faithfully captures Miku's expression brimming with hope, and the contrast of light and shadow that make LAM's work so distinctive. Every detail, from her intense presence to the meticulously recreated shades, has been fully sculpted and painted for fans to enjoy.Adding to her allure is the inclusion of a massive speaker, with parts cleverly crafted from clear material to seamlessly incorporate optional LED lights (sold separately), granting it a cool, luminescent quality.The precision craftsmanship extends to her megaphone microphone - not only in its intricacy but also in capturing the unique color gradations akin to screen tones.Own the embodiment of a poised and cool hero Miku that appears in the nick of time!Fully Supported by the Production Committee:The main visual of Hatsune Miku Magical Mirai 2023, illustrated by LAM, was brought to life in full collaboration with the Magical Mirai Production Committee. Craftsmen at Design COCO breathed life into the life-sized statue exhibited at the event, paying homage to LAM's creation. In the same spirit, Design COCO, in collaboration with the Magical Mirai Production Committee, scaled down the life-sized Hatsune Miku to a 1/7 figure size. The transformation didn't involve mere scaling; meticulous adjustments were made to the 3D model to harmonize with the figure's scale, proportions, sculpting, and coloring.The Theme of Magical Mirai 2023 - HERO :The vivid red costume exudes its texture, while the embodiment of Miku's full power is expressed through precise sculpting. The distinct touch of LAM's illustration is faithfully replicated through meticulous coloring. Her gaze and expression, brimming with strength and hope, are painstakingly rendered. The result is a Miku that seems to leap out of LAM's artwork - an ultra-cool and charming representation.Precise Craftsmanship for the Megaphone Mic and Speaker:The megaphone microphone's precision craftsmanship extends to its coloring, emulating the appearance of affixed screen tones. Some parts of the giant speaker are constructed using clear material, allowing integration with separately available LED lights for a captivating cool luminosity.Cool from Every Angle:From her bright gaze, powerful costume, and stylish red and green intertwined twin tails, every angle offers an impressive view.Experience the captivating allure of Miku - the poised and cool savior who emerges when the going gets tough.Figure Size: Approximately 200mm tall (Including Base)Materials (Tentative): PVC, ABSSculptor: Design COCO (Producer: A2C)Coloring: Design COCO (Producer: A2C)Due to restrictions on this item by the manufacturer, we are unable to ship this product to China (Macau, Hong Kong and Taiwan are OK).

You can also display her together with the second in the series, Megurine Luka, to start your S-style collection! Note: Includes Miku Hatsune Swimsuit Ver. PVC only. The Luka Megurine Swimsuit Ver. PVC is sold separately.

name: 1/8 Racing Miku Thai Ver. PVC
description: From the Good Smile Company website: The Hatsune Miku GT Project's mascot character Racing Miku was specially illustrated for the 2014 Thailand race, and that illustration has now been transformed into this 1/8th scale figure!Racing Miku's skin has been tanned a lovely golden brown by the warm sun and clear skies of southern Thailand, as she looks ahead with a cool and clear gaze. She is posed sitting in the director's chair during a race, taking a little break before getting back to cheering the team on!

name: RAH Hatsune Miku Project DIVA F Honey Whip Deluxe ver.
description: Hatune Miku returns to the Real Action Heroes line wearing her Honey Whip Module from the rhythm game Project Diva F ! Miku measures about 30cm tall, and this special Honey Whip Deluxe version comes with a variety of great accessories from the game to enjoy!Miku comes with 4 facial expressions: a smiling expression, a winking face, a singing face with her eyes closed and a shy expression. On top of her Honey Whip Module outfit, the Deluxe version also includes an alternate outfit and hair parts to recreate her Supreme Module! Optional hand parts and a figure stand are also included so you can dress the digital diva and pose her in an endless number of ways!

name: 1/7 Racing Miku 2014: EV MIRAI Ver. PVC
description: From the manufacturer: A 1/7th scale figure of the electronic diva that travels at the speed of sound! The Hatsune Miku GT Project's mascot character Racing Miku teamed up with the electric motorbike manufacturer TEAM MIRAI to become Racing Miku 2014: EV MIRAI Ver. which has now been made into this 1/7th scale figure!She is wearing the 2014 biker suit designed by Shigeto Koyama, walking along confidently with her long twintails fluttering behind her! The reverse side of her that was never visible on the original illustration is also filled with highlights for fans to enjoy. Enjoy adding this cute, sporty Miku to your collection!

name: 1/4 Hatsune Miku V3 PVC
description: From the GoodSmile website:A 1/4th scale figure of Hatsune Miku, standing an incredible 42cm in height!The Hatsune Miku V3 key visual illustration by iXima has been sculpted into a massive 1/4th scale figure, which stands an impressive 42cm in height.The twin tails winding around her body have been sculpted with the utmost detail, with incredible care also given to the intricacies of her outfit--bringing out a level of realism and detail that can only be achieved through such a large scale figure. This is the work of art that Miku fans have been waiting for--a Miku figure that, both literally and figuratively, stands above the rest!(In the photo showing the figure standing next to a CD-ROM, the CD-ROM is there just for size comparison; the figure does not come with a CD-ROM.)

name: figma Racing Miku 2014 EV Mirai
description: From the GoodSmile website:Racing Miku 2014: EV MIRAI ver. is going to be challenging the Pikes Peak Hill climb with the electric motorbike TT Zero 13 Kai, and is now being transformed into a figma too!The Hatsune Miku GT project official character Racing Miku joined forces with the electric bike manufacturer TEAM MIRAI to become the EV MIRAI ver. The 2014 version features a bike suit!She comes with two expressions, including a slightly surprised-looking expression as well as a smiling expression.A helmet and shift:body to display her riding on a motorbike are both included.A flexible plastic is used for important areas, allowing proportions to be kept without compromising posability, and an articulated figma stand is included.Note: includes figma Racing Miku 2014 EV Mirai only. Ex:ride Spride.07 TT Zero 13 Kai is sold separately.

name: 1/7 Miku Hatsune Risa Ebata Ver PVC
description: From the Good Smile Company website:A 1/7th scale figure of Hatsune Miku based on an illustration by the popular illustrator Risa Ebata! The unique translucent and delicate appearance of Risa Ebata's illustration has been carefully preserved in figure form.She is seated on a magnificent floating diamond that shines beneath her with a love innocent smile on her face, as her long winding twintails are swaying in the wind behind her. A truly intricate piece of sculpting that fans are sure to fall in love with. Enjoy a different side and all new charm of Hatsune Miku through this collaboration!

name: 1/8 Racing Miku 2014 Ver. PVC
description: From the GoodSmile website:The world's fastest diva, ready to guide the Z4 to the top with her beautiful voice!GOODSMILE RACING & TeamUKYO is currently taking part in the GT300 class races of Japan's top motor racing series, the SUPER GT, under the banner of the Hatsune Miku GT Project. The mascot character for the project is none other than Racing Miku, who is back again in 1/8th scale, this time dressed up in her 2014 outfit!This season's Racing Miku was illustrated by the up-and-coming illustrator Oguchi with design direction by Shigeto Koyama, famous for his work in various anime series! The two of them have come together to create a design that fans have come to love, which has now become a scale figure to join collections around the world!The delicate gradient shading in Miku's freely flowing twin tails and boots, the unique design of her outfit, and her sweet smile all combine to make this figure a must-have for Miku fans everywhere!

name: Mamama-Shiki Api Miku Hatsune Figure
description: Taito's debut figure of Hatsune Miko is here! She's a game-prize item, and is about 20cm tall.

name: Nendoroid Miku Hatsune Senbonzakura Ver.
description: From the GoodSmile website:A bold and audacious transformation into a Nendoroid!A Nendoroid of Hatsune Miku based on the outfit she wore in the song Senbonzakura by Kurousa-P! She comes with a gentle smiling face as well as an energetic winking expression for various different different poses.In addition, the cherry blossom streamer and cherry blossom-themed bicycle seen in the original music video are also both included! Using the special included parts that attach to her feet, you can display her without the need of the support arm in her classic shooting pose while looking over her shoulder!

name: 1/8 Hatsune Miku Tell Your World Ver. PVC
description: This figure of Miku Hatsune is based on the cover illustration for her song Tell Your World, which was used in a Google Chrome commercial. She looks sweet and shy, in her colorful flower-print top with her black skirt swirling in an unseen breeze. The design was a collaboration between Fantasista Utamaro and Mebae, and she was masterfully sculpted by Iwanaga Sakurako (Shokubutu Shojo-en). Miku is about 21cm tall, and will come with a base.

name: 1/7 Mikuzukin PVC
description: From the Good Smile Company website: From SEGA's rhythm game Hatsune Miku -Project DIVA- 2nd comes a 1/7th scale figure of one of the most popular 'module' outfits from the game, Mikuzukin! All the details of her outfit have been carefully sculpted onto the figure, including the large red hood with a cute little wolf peeking out from the top!The figure is filled with various adorable highlights such as the white apron with flower prints, the large red ribbon on her chest and even the cute wolf shape she is making with her right hand!

name: 1/8 Racing Miku Sepang Ver.
description: From the Good Smile website:The fastest diva under the sun is here in her Sepang Ver.! The Hatsune Miku GT Project's mascot character Racing Miku was illustrated cheering on the team at the 2013 Sepang Circuit, and that version of Miku has now been made into a figure!Her sleek curves and colorful wings - even the tanned color of her skin have all been faithfully preserved on the figure. The smallest of details from her unique design leave tons of highlights for fans to enjoy! Enjoy the company of the sexy tanned Racing Miku, ready to cheer you on whenever you need it!

name: Racing Miku 2014
description: Hatsune Miku returns as the mascot for GOODSMILE RACING & TeamUKYO for the 2014 SUPER GT motor racing series with her new 2014 design! Her cool, blue hair and the black accents of her outfit really pop against the white of her bodysuit, and the digital diva looks more confident as ever as she poses for the camera! Miku measures about 18cm tall. Make her a part of your collection today!

name: figma Racing Miku 2013 EV Mirai Ver.
description: Hatsune Miku returns to us in Racing form in this new figma based off an original illustration by artist saitom! This special EV Mirai Ver. of Racing Miku was featured as a mascot on the electric bike 'TT Zero 13' which took part in the Isle of Man TT race, and now she's ready to race into your heart!With her bike suit pulled down and tied around her waist to reveal her silver tank top, Miku is ready to take a breather with you before hopping back on her motorbike for another few laps! She includes a standard expression and a bright smile. Also included are a helmet, drinking bottle, extra parts for her bike suit sleeves, and a figma stand. Includes Racing Miku 2013 figma only! Ex:ride Spride TT Zero 13 motorbike is not included.

name: POP! Rock Series: Vocaloid Hatsune Miku
description: Beloved Vocaloid character Miku Hatsune soars to new heights of cuteness with her POP! Rock debut! The nice people at Funko have given Miku a minimalist makeover, and she's now adorable as heck. Made of soft vinyl, she stands 9cm tall.

name: 1/8 Senbonzakura feat. Miku Hatsune PVC
description: Senbonzakura, as performed by Miku Hatsune, is one of the most popular downloadable songs ever in Japan. This figure by Freeing depicts the Vocaloid sensation as she appears in the video for the song, wearing a stylized uniform and pointing playfully behind her as the wind swirls her twin tails and long sleeves around her. The muted colors and traditional styling of her outfit is quite a change from what we usually see Miku wearing! A base is included (which may be different from the one seen in the prototype photos), and she can be displayed with or without her hat, too. She'll be about 20cm tall.

name: 1/8 Racing Miku 2013 Ver. PVC
description: From the Goodsmile Company website: The fastest songstress on the racing circuit, Racing Miku 2013 ver.! GSR&Studie with TeamUKYO took part in the GT300 class races of one Japan's most well known motor races, the SUPER GT 2013, and they finished the season in third place! The main mascot character for the team is of course Racing Miku, who has been sculpted in a 1/8th scale for fans of both Miku and the racing team to enjoy. Racing Miku 2013 was illustrated by saitom with costume design by Mari Shimazaki - both of their unique touches have been preserved on the figure to bring a high quality design and sculpt that fans will be proud to own! Approximately 185mm in height.

name: 1/8 Hatsune Miku Shinkai Shoujo Ver. PVC (Deep Sea Girl)
description: Feel the motion of the ocean! Artist Haruyo produced a lovely illustration for the Yuuyu-P song Deep Sea Girl, and that image inspired this gorgeous figure of Miku Hatsune! Miku's famously long hair, tinted more blue than usual by the ocean's depths, flows gently with the movement of the water, as do her hair ribbons and the ruffles on her dress. Sculpted by Iwanaga Sakurako of Shokubutu Shojo-en, this figure is about 16cm tall, and the base with the coral and rocks is included. Take this beautiful sea nymph home with you today!

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku Type 2020 PVC
description: This gorgeous figure of Hatsune Miku is based on an illustration by Shirow Miwa. She appears in the videogame 7th Dragon 2020, and this figure replicates her appearance in the game, with painstakingly detailed sculpting and painting to reproduce her outfit as closely as possible. She's about 25cm tall, and some minor assembly is needed--you'll need to plug her pigtails into her head and attach her to the checkerboard-patterned base (different than the base shown in these prototype photos). Take this lovely diva home with you today!

name: Real Action Heroes Hatsune Miku -Project DIVA- F
description: Medicom presents, live and in person, Miku Hatsune from Sega's PlayStation game Project DIVA F ! She's about 28cm tall, and is fully posable, wearing her iconic outfit. She comes with two interchangeable faces, extra hands, and a keyboard with a stand. She's ready to perform for you!

She's about 19cm tall, and she's ready to join your lineup today! Mass-produced products often show minor inconsistencies in paint and finish, which are not considered defects.

name: 1/7 Racing Miku 2012 Ver. PVC
description: Here comes Racing Miku! Wearing the 2012 version of her outfit, the official mascot of the Hatsune Miku 2012 GT Project laughs with joy and waves a deep-pink-and-black checkered flag, signaling victory for a lucky driver! Supports are included for those extravagant twin tails, as is a base for her to stand on. She stands about 26cm tall. Mass-produced products often show minor inconsistencies in paint and finish, which are not considered defects.

description: A set of three cute racers (Rin, Miku, and Ruka) plus a grand prix podium and a racing car! The car comes in pure white, with decals you apply yourself. Mass-produced products may show minor inconsistencies in paint and finish, which are not considered defects.

name: Mikumo Miku Hatsune Imagination Scene Figure #06 Yume Miru Kotori
description: Here's Miku Hatsune as seen in an illustration done for a video for her song Yume Miru Kotori, looking especially winsome in a summery yukata! She's 8cm tall. Mass-produced products may show minor inconsistencies in paint and finish, which are not considered defects.

name: Mikumo #05 Imagination Scene Figure Traveling Mood Miku Hatsune
description: Miku Hatsune kicks her way across a rain-choked street, as seen in the video for the song Traveling Mood ! She's about 10cm tall, and she's ready to make you smile!

name: 1/7 Character Vocal Series #01: Miku Hatsune HSP Ver. PVC
description: This adorable version of Miku Hatsune is based on illustrations by Hiro Kanzaki for Hana Soumen P's videos of the fan-favorite Vocaloid character! She's a bit younger than we're used to seeing here, and she has an awesomely detailed keyboard that's apparently powered by a green octopus-like critter at her feet! She's about 21cm tall, and a base is included.

name: Mikumo #04 Romeo & Cinderella Miku Hatsune
description: Vocaloid idol Miku Hatsune reclines in her pajamas on a giant high-heeled shoe, about to bite into a juicy apple... but she's been distracted by a red rose! Who left it there? This charming little vignette is about 8cm tall and 11cm long, so it's just the right size to bring a colorful touch of Miku to somewhere you don't have a lot of room.

name: Mikumo #03 Original Collection LOL -Lots of Laugh- Hatsune Miku
description: From the music video from her performance of -Lots of Laugh- , Miku Hatsune tumbles amid a variety of sweet treats! This charming vignette is about 13cm tall, and includes the pink rabbit that she dreamed about that fateful night.

name: Nendoroid Hatsune Miku Append
description: Miku Hatsune's Append version now joins the Nendoroid family! She's 10cm tall, and is super-cute, of course; she features three facial expressions, interchangeable arms, an interchangeable body for awakened mode, and--perhaps best of all--her base has LED lights, so you can display her in her famous floating pose!

name: Mikumo Miku Hatsune Imagination Scene Figure #02 Marukunaru
description: Miku Hatsune, Rin Kagamine and Len Kagamine are all depicted as adorable cats, blissfully asleep on a cloud!

name: Mikumo Miku Hatsune Imagination Scene Figure #01 Koiiro Byoutou
description: As she appeared in a Nico Nico Douga video for her song Koiiro Byoutou, here's Miku Hatsune in a pink nurse's outfit! She's got the cure for you--and so does the super-cute version of Miku, soaring off into space on a large hypodermic needle! This colorful vignette is about 13cm tall.

name: 1/8 Hatsune Miku Love is War Ver. PVC
description: Love is war--but Miku Hatsune is on your side! This dramatic figure of everyone's favorite Vocaloid mascot character depicts Miku as seen in illustrations by Shirou Miwa--standing on a balcony with a megaphone in one hand and her twin tails flying behind her! The whole setup is about 20cm tall, and will make an unforgettable centerpiece of your collection. This item is too large to be shipped by SAL Small Packet; the SAL shipping cost estimate shown above is for SAL Parcel.

name: 1/8 Miku Hatsune Append PVC
description: Based on the illustration appearing on the cover of the Append upgrade for the Vocaloid Miku Hatsune voice synthesizer program, this gorgeous figure will bring a touch of elegance to your shelf. Some simple assembly is required--just pop her twin tails into place and place her on the support arm for the base, and then put the speakers on the base and you're done. With her translucent hair flowing upward and a meditative expression on her face, you'll fall in love with this new version of Miku all over again.

name: Figma Miku Hatsune Append Ver.
description: Honored with being the 100th Figma, here comes Miku Hatsune Append! Miku Hatsune: Append is a new set of voices for the Miku Hatsune Vocaloid to update and improve her sound, and a new character design was also created; she makes a perfect Figma! In her carefully painted sleek bodysuit and leggings, with charmingly bare feet, Miku stands about 13.5cm tall. She has three different faces: a smile, an awakening face with closed eyes (her twin tails are jointed so you can recreate her floating pose from the cover of the software package), and a more grown-up look. The mecha parts attached to her hips, upper arms and chest can be removed and replaced as you like, and a stand with a jointed posing arm is also included. This highly posable figure of the world's most beloved Vocaloid is ready to add a touch of music to your collection!

name: 1/8 Miku Hatsune Lat-Type Ver. PVC
description: This Miku is based on a 3D CG model of the popular Vocaloid singing sensation created by the artist Lat for the program MikuMikuDance. She differs from other Mikus in that her headphones are charmingly oversized, and a red bracelet tattoo replaces the 01 on her left arm. Her red glasses make her extra-cute (she can be displayed without them if you prefer), and the chain strap on her skirt has a checkerboard design. Of course, like every other version of Miku, she's cute as can be, and she loves to sing and dance! She was sculpted by Akeji, and she's about 17cm tall; a base is included. She's ready to dance her way into your collection!

name: 1/8 Racing Miku PVC
description: Have you ever seen a more irresistible smile? Miku Hatsune makes an appearance in her role as the official mascot for the 2010 Super GT Racing Team Good Smile Racing with COX --and she looks fabulous! Based on an illustration by redjuice, her sassy mechanic's uniform is sexy yet functional--check out the headphones/ear protectors!--and she's armed with a socket wrench and a pouch full o' tools for when it's time to help out in the pit. She stands about 20cm tall.

name: 1/7 Miku Hatsune PVC Tony Version
description: Wow, is this one ever a hot ticket-! Miku Hatsune, one of the most popular characters in the world, as drawn by Tony Taka, one of the most highly thought-of illustrators, is now a fantastic figure from Max Factory! In an energetic dancing pose, Miku looks over one shoulder and extends a hand to her audience with a joyous smile, while her twin tails swirl around her like a whirlwind! She is sculpted by Chieri, who expertly catches every nuance of Tony's illustration--and then some, having to sculpt the sides not seen in the 2D image! Every detail has been captured perfectly, down to her hand clutching the microphone, the swing of her skirt, and the carefully sculpted wrinkles in the waist area of her dress. Miku stands about 21.5cm tall, and a base is included.

name: 1/8 Miku Hatsune VN02 Mix PVC
description: It's Miku Hatsune as you've never seen her before! Based on an illustration by Nagimiso for the VN02 mix of Miku's song moon, this stunning figure depicts the world-famous Vocaloid songstress soaring with her twin tails flowing luxuriously behind her, her arms extended and leaning forward with the speed of her trajectory. Her outfit is more like a mecha than clothing, with its winglike nacelles and intake ports. Miku's gorgeous face is eerily calm as she launches herself forward into the future.

name: Vocaloid Miku Hatsune Premium Figure
description: Miku Hatsune, with her hair in blue rather than her usual shade of teal green, is doing what she loves best--performing for an adoring audience! Captured in a lively pose, this game-prize item from Sega requires some simple assembly (attach her twin tails to her head, attach her feet to the base, and prop the ends of her twin tails on the special support), and when you're done, you'll have a super-cute version of Miku for your collection!

name: Nendoroid Plus Vocaloid Pullback Car Miku & Green Onion Car
description: Miku Hatsune is ready to go for a cruise in her car, shaped just like her favorite vegetable--a green onion (or leek, if you prefer)! Place the car on a flat surface, pull it back, and watch Miku zip along! A petite 8cm long, this charming little toy is ready to bring a touch of fun to your day.

name: 1/8 supercell feat. Miku Hatsune World is Mine Natural Frame Ver. PVC
description: Accurately based on supercell's beautiful World is Mine picture video with music composed by ryo and graphics by redjuice, this magnificent PVC display piece captures the regal figure of Princess Miku in stunning detail and presented on a natural frame base! It measures 22cm in height with the included stand and 18cm tall without the stand.

name: 1/8 supercell feat. Miku Hatsune World is Mine Brown Frame Ver. PVC
description: Accurately based on supercell's beautiful World is Mine picture video with music composed by ryo and graphics by redjuice, this magnificent PVC display piece captures the regal figure of Princess Miku in stunning detail and presented on a brown frame base! It measures 22cm in height with the included stand and 18cm tall without the stand.

name: 1/7 Miku Hatsune PVC
description: One of the most highly anticipated figures of the year is finally here! Miku Hatsune, the hugely popular mascot character from the Vocaloid voice-synthesizer software, poses in her customary black-and-teal outfit that combines tomorrow's technology with schoolgirl sweetness (and just a touch of lolita). She's ready to perform, with her microphone and headphones in place, and yet she still seems the tiniest bit shy. This PVC figure of the world's favorite digital diva darling stands about 23cm tall, and was sculpted by Shiningwizard@Sawachika. A smart-looking black-and-silver base is included to display her.

name: Nendoroid Plus Stuffed Miku Hatsune
description: Here's a small, portable Miku Hachune who's just the right size to ride along with you in your car, or to sit on a shelf. This cuddly plush version of the world-famous Vocaloid spokesmodel is posable, thanks to an inner skeleton in her arms, legs, and even her pigtails!

name: Nendoroid Plus Stuffed Miku Hachune
description: This cuddly plush of a shocked-looking Miku Hachune is posable, thanks to an inner skeleton in her arms, legs, and even her pigtails! She comes complete with a leek in one hand, so you can relive the excitement of the Ilevan Polkka anytime you like.

name: figma Miku Hatsune
description: Super-popular Vocaloid character Miku Hatsune makes her action figure debut with this superb Figma offering from Max Factory! Standing 13cm tall, Miku is clad in her beautifully detailed stage outfit, and features a high level of articulation thanks to the ingenious Figma joints that allow you to recreate her lively stage poses! She comes packed with accessories that include two long onions, a microphone and mike stand, eight optional hands, an interchangeable face, and a figure display base with stand. Impressive!

name: 1/8 Miku Hatsune PVC
description: Vocaloid mascot character Miku Hatsune now comes to fans as this gorgeously sculpted PVC rendition that's carefully finished and ready for a spotlight display in any collection! Based on one of creator Kei's original illustrations, Miku is brought to life in sharp 3D detail, from her characteristic twin tails to the hand on her headset, looking as if she's about to sing! A hexagonal display base is provided.

Vocaloid Hatsune Miku Rascal Trio-Try-iT Akuma
description: What's cuter than a devilish diva with a fluffy companion? Behold the captivating Hatsune Miku in her Akuma version, crafted by FuRyu! This prize figure features Miku embracing her mischievous side, complete with charming bat wings and a stylish gothic outfit that gleams in the light. Her teal locks cascade beautifully, perfectly framed by playful twin tails, while the intricate details of her attire, adorned with belts and lace, make her pop against any backdrop. But wait! The adorable Rascal joins the fun, nestled in Miku's arms, adding a whimsical touch that amplifies her playful charm. Wit

name: Vocaloid Hatsune Miku Rascal Special Figure Summer Festival
description: Is there anything more delightful than a summer festival with your favorite virtual idol? Here comes Hatsune Miku, dressed in a stunning kimono-themed outfit that shimmers with summer vibes! This enchanting prize figure captures Miku mid-dance, her long flowing hair accented with cheerful sunflowers, evoking the warmth of sunny days. Her vibrant blue locks cascade around her, while she gracefully holds a cute plush Rascal, adding a playful touch to her festive look. The delicate details on her kimono blend traditional elegance with modern flair, making this figure a perfect addition to any col
